title: PAGE: Parts-Aware Guidance for Co-Speech Gesture Portrait Video Generation
title_zh: 面向协同语音手势肖像视频生成的部件感知引导方法

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种名为PAGE的方法，用于通过单张参考图像和语音信号生成高质量的协同语音手势肖像视频。 Co-speech gesture video generation aims to synthesize realistic, audio-driven portrait videos from a single reference image and a speech signal. Despite advances in visual quality, diffusion-based approaches still suffer from degraded local details and imperfect audio-visual alignment. We present PAGE (Parts-Aware GuidancE), a general, backbone-agnostic optimization framework for diffusion-based generation that enhances local spatial fidelity and global audio-visual consistency at both the training-objective and denoising-trajectory levels. During training, we propose Parts-Specific Reweighting (PSR), which adaptively increases supervision in semantically important regions such as lips, eyes, and hands, improving visual fidelity in perceptually critical areas. During inference, we introduce Consistency Classifier Guidance (CCG), an audio-conditioned latent classifier that identifies and corrects audio-visual inconsistencies in the generated video. We further design Differential Guidance (DG), an efficient inference strategy that refines facial and body motion separately while avoiding cross-region interference. To enable large-scale evaluation, we construct the Chinese Announcer Speech (CAS) dataset, the first comprehensive Chinese benchmark for co-speech gesture portrait video generation. Compared with the widely used PATS dataset, CAS includes substantially more identities, video clips, and scene diversity. Extensive experiments on both PATS and CAS demonstrate that PAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance in perceptual quality, gesture diversity, and audio-visual alignment. Project page: https://aigc-explorer.github.io/PAGE/.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种名为PAGE的方法，用于通过单张参考图像和语音信号生成高质量的协同语音手势肖像视频。协同语音手势视频生成旨在从单张参考图像和语音信号中合成逼真的、由音频驱动的肖像视频。 尽管视觉质量取得了进步，基于扩散模型的方法仍然存在局部细节退化以及音视频对齐不完美的问题。 我们提出了PAGE（Parts-Aware GuidancE），一种通用且与骨干网络无关的基于扩散模型的生成优化框架，能够在训练目标和去噪轨迹两个层面提升局部空间保真度和全局音视频一致性。 在训练阶段，我们提出了部件特定重新加权（PSR）方法，该方法能自适应地增强对嘴唇、眼睛和手等语义重要区域的监督，从而提升感知关键区域的视觉保真度。 在推理阶段，我们引入了一致性分类器引导（CCG），这是一种以音频为条件的潜在空间分类器，能够识别并纠正生成视频中的音视频不一致问题。 我们还设计了差异引导（DG）策略，这是一种高效的推理方法，能够在避免区域间干扰的同时分别优化面部和身体动作。 为实现大规模评估，我们构建了中文播报语音（CAS）数据集，这是首个面向协同语音手势肖像视频生成的综合性中文基准数据集。 与广泛使用的PATS数据集相比，CAS包含了更多身份、视频片段以及更丰富的场景多样性。 在PATS和CAS数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，PAGE在感知质量、手势多样性和音视频对齐方面均达到了当前最优水平。 项目页面：https://aigc-explorer.github.io/PAGE/。
